Just a few random sync style-only test-only fixups. See the commit msgs for the rationales.

<commits>
facf4a0ea9 test: Remove redundant sync_blocks

Both self.generate() and self.test_witness_block(accept=True) sync
blocks internally.

fa2986921c test: Use generateblock with submit=False over manual create_block from tmpl

Suggested by L0rinc in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35728#discussion_r4441552525

fa6f1c00c5 test: Use send_self_transfer_chain

Use the tx-chain helper instead of manual chaining.
Suggested by L0rinc in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35728#discussion_r4441559708

Also, drop the unused index sync, which happens via the default
wait_for_full_init=True when starting the node.
</commits>
